name: Galaxy S III

images.credit: GadgetsGuy, CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: 2G GSM/GPRS/EDGE: 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz, 3G UMTS/CDMA2000/HSPA+: 850, 900, 1700, 1800 (Korean Pcs LG U+), 1900, 2100 MHz, 4G LTE: 700, 800, 850, 1700, 1800, 1900, 2500, 2600 MHz, TD-SCDMA (China Mobile Variant) and GT-i9305

Body.Dimensions: 136.6 mm H, 70.6 mm W, 8.6 mm (9.0 mm on South Korean model) D

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 4.0.4 "Ice Cream Sandwich", Current: Android 4.3 "Jelly Bean", Android 4.4.2 "KitKat" (2 GB RAM variants and GT-I9301I Neo only), Unofficial: Android 14 "Upside Down Cake" via LineageOS 21.0 Unofficial for Samsung Galaxy S III GT-I9300 Exynos Variant, Android 8.1 "Oreo" via LineageOS 15.1 Unofficial for Samsung Galaxy S III d2 Snapdragon variants
Platform.Chipset: Samsung Exynos 4 Quad (GT-I9300), Qualcomm Snapdragon S4 MSM8960 (U.S & Canada & Japan variants), Qualcomm Snapdragon 400 MSM8228 (GT-I9301I Neo)
Platform.CPU: 1.4 GHz quad-core Cortex-A9 (GT-I9300), 1.3 GHz dual-core Krait (U.S. & Canada & Japan variants), 1.2 GHz quad-core ARM Cortex-A7 (GT-I9301I Neo)
Platform.GPU: Mali-400 MP4 (GT-I9300), Adreno 225 (U.S. & Canada & Japan variants), Adreno 305 (GT-I9301I Neo)

Memory.RAM: 1 GB RAM (international version), 2 GB RAM (LTE versions, selected markets), 1.5 GB RAM (GT-I9301I Neo)

Cameras.Front camera: 1.9 megapixels, Zero shutter lag, HD video (720p) at 30 frames/s

Battery.Battery: 2,100 mAh, 7.98 Wh, 3.8 V Li-ion, User replaceable
